publicBenchmark.disclosure: All scores are frozen, duration-weighted, composition-held-out, and enharmonically canonicalized. The 98% objective has not been met; every corpus is shown rather than averaged away. Travis songs were not used.
publicBenchmark.metricSemantics: Enharmonic root and bass spellings are compared by pitch class; chord quality remains exact for detailed recall.
publicBenchmark.selectionRule: CQT root-guide weight 0.3 selected on composition-held-out development splits across all four datasets; all sealed test reports generated once after selection
